title: AI Agent Tester
subtitle: Automated Testing Oracle & LLM Evaluation Engine
summary: Automated Python testing oracle for deterministic batch evaluation of LLM outputs using keyword matching, structured JSON logging, and Zero Trust secret management.
overview: Validating AI agent behaviors at scale can quickly become a logistical nightmare. AI Agent Tester addresses this challenge by functioning as an automated oracle focused on stressing, verifying, and validating LLM agent outputs deterministically and auditably.
responsibilities: Designed data flow architecture and automated batch test orchestration via the OpenAI API.
Built deterministic lexical matching test suites and CSV-driven parameterization.
Implemented the core Python 3.10 test runner with response sanitization and unittest integration.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Achieving predictable and repeatable validations over non-deterministic, probabilistic generative language models.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Engineered a rapid lexical inference engine validating mandatory target keywords, transforming open-ended semantic parsing into a fast, binary deterministic test.

metrics: 100% automation in smoke test validations eliminating manual response inspection
Standardized auditable JSON output for seamless CI/CD pipeline integration
Native unittest suite ensuring regression-free runner execution

owaspMitigations.title: Cryptographic Failures / Secrets Management
owaspMitigations.description: Zero Trust isolation of sensitive credentials (OPENAI_API_KEY) via environment variables and restricted .env configuration.

owaspMitigations.title: Injection
owaspMitigations.description: Strict payload sanitization preventing prompt injections from corrupting structured JSON logs.
